title: SpaceVLLM: Endowing Multimodal Large Language Model with Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Capability
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: SpaceVLLM: Endowing Multimodal Large Language Model with Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Capability Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable progress in temporal or spatial localization tasks, but struggle with joint spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG).

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: However, the challenging task of Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) [60], which requires locating a spatio-temporal tube corresponding to a specific instance described by a caption, remains underexplored by existing MLLMs.

methods.name: Multi-Modal Fusion and Feature Enhancement
methods.evidence_sentence: We identify two key bottlenecks hindering this capability: (1) the sheer number of visual tokens makes long-range and fine-grained visual modeling challenging; (2) generating a long sequence of bounding boxes in text makes it hard to accurately align each box with its specific video frame.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: To further facilitate research in this area, we propose an automated data synthesis pipeline to construct \textbf{V-STG} dataset, comprising 110K STVG instances.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: To this end, we propose \textbf{\textit{SpaceVLLM}}, a MLLM equipped with spatio-temporal video grounding capabilities.
